lines.en: On the windswept savanna, I walk slowly.

lines.zh: 金合欢的树影，跟着我走。
lines.en: The acacia's shadow walks along with me.
Bone for joints; a steady gait.

lines.zh: 稀树的影子，替我遮一会儿。
lines.en: The acacia shade covers me a while.

lines.zh: 草原上，白骨被晒得发亮。
lines.en: On the savanna, bones bake bright.
Warm soil underfoot; I keep walking.
Another ring has grown into my ribs.
Three steps, then stand and bask.
Every step shakes off a leaf.
The wind turned my dead leaves over.
My shadow leans left; I follow it.
Moss rubs against my pelvis.
I stand still; the sun does the moving.

lines.zh: 草原的太阳晒得我骨头响。
lines.en: The savanna sun makes my bones creak.

lines.zh: 草原的日头，把箭杆晒裂了。
lines.en: The savanna sun has cracked my arrow shafts.
Dead leaves dream of rain.
On the savanna, I stand very straight.
The cloud's gone. I still haven't budded.
A hundred years is one blink.
My breath runs through my roots.
Dry grass pokes into my ribs.

lines.zh: 我这副骨头，被太阳晒得发白。
lines.en: Sun has bleached these bones white.

lines.zh: 旱风把我影子吹长了一格。
lines.en: The dry wind stretched my shadow a block.
Sunbathing, do not disturb.

lines.zh: 又一片金合欢叶落在我肩上。
lines.en: Another acacia leaf landed on my shoulder.
Quiet. Let my roots stretch in the soil.
Blooming waits till my ribs dry through.
I've counted to the hundredth ring.

lines.zh: 草原的枯草，缠着我的腿骨。
lines.en: Dry grass tangles my leg bones.

lines.zh: 草原的干草底下，我藏得很好。
lines.en: Under dry savanna grass I hide well.
The soil knows your steps before I do.
Why would a rock be breathing?
There's light in your sockets too.
So you're the one Savanna Skeleton mentioned.

lines.zh: 草原的箭，是用干枝削的。
lines.en: Savanna arrows are whittled from dry branch.
Three leaves crushed under your heel.
I've watched this meadow a hundred years.
Turn around; let me see your bones.
You smell of wet clay.
That iron in your hand keeps catching light.
Did the wind bring you, or the rain?
My thorns outlast the acacia's.

lines.zh: 谁在折我骨头上长的枝。
lines.en: Who's snapping the branches off my bones?
A fresh split in my ribs.

lines.zh: 叶子掉了，我的肋骨不碍事。
lines.en: A leaf fell, and my ribs are fine.
Bark peeled back, bone showing.
Dry grass rasps against my bones.

lines.zh: 这一箭穿过我肋骨，卡在里头。
lines.en: The arrow passed my ribs and stuck.
My bones are brittle. Don't hammer them.
This scar goes on my rings.
That branch grew only last year.
It hurts enough to curl my roots.
That water — pour it on my roots.
Soil this rich is just unfair.
I've forgotten even the word sweet.

lines.zh: 干草底下，我的骨头露出来。
lines.en: Under the dry grass, my bones show.
A fruit rolled up beside my roots.
Set it down and back off to that tree.
Trees don't bite. We use branches.
Dry grass is stuck in my ribs.
Every branch leans your way.
Mushroom smell rising from the soil.

lines.zh: 骨头老了，撞一次掉一片。
lines.en: Old bones: one bump, one leaf lost.
You're carrying three of my leaves.
Wind only shoves me. You crash into me.
My flower fell in the dirt. Return it.

lines.zh: 草原的太阳，把我的骨头晒黄了。
lines.en: The savanna sun yellowed my bones.
The road is wide. You hit me anyway.
The dry grass pricks at my bones.
Touch again and my thorns turn.
Both step back, and the grass quiets.
You snapped one of my side roots.

lines.zh: 风把草籽吹到我骨头上。
lines.en: Wind blows grass seed onto my bones.

lines.zh: 草原的花，开在我骨缝里。
lines.en: Savanna flowers bloom in my ribs.
Petals open, waiting for the wind.
Once the grass seeds, I'll move on.
Twist our roots till they won't part.
The dry season's short — let's hurry.
The wind's loud. Come closer to speak.

lines.zh: 影子先碰上了，你看见没。
lines.en: Our shadows touched first. Did you see?
When the rain comes, we drink together.
Let me hand you my pollen first.
Bury it and let it sprout.
Three arrows left in my quiver.
This leaf goes under my roots.
Iron rusts. Bone doesn't.
A round stone in the grass. Perfect.

lines.zh: 草根里埋的骨头，都是我的。
lines.en: The bones in these roots are mine.
What falls to earth belongs to the tree.

lines.zh: 草原的日头，把我的骨头晒黄了。
lines.en: The savanna sun bleached my bones yellow.
Found on the savanna. Not returning it.
Bury bone deeper; the soil gets richer.
Turning back won't show you my branch.
You've stepped into my shadow.
My last swing was last dry season.
My roots felt your feet first.
Don't run. My rings aren't in a hurry.
Grass roots count your steps.
Savanna sun bleaches bones yellow.
Sun reaches my branch. I move.

lines.zh: 草原上就你一只虫，动手。
lines.en: Only one bug on the savanna — that's you.

lines.zh: 稀树的刺，挂住了我的骨头。
lines.en: An acacia thorn has snagged my bone.

lines.zh: 这片旱草甸，我跑得比你熟。
lines.en: I know this dry meadow better than you.
I draw my bow under a dead tree.
One more step puts you in my arms.
I shift an inch; you're an inch closer.
You turn; my branches turn too.
Dry-season bones are light as grass.
This soil underfoot is mine.
Dry branches lie across your path.
See my shadow changing places?
Your sweat soaks into the dry soil.

lines.zh: 百年的枝，你挡一下试试。
lines.en: Try blocking a hundred-year branch.
My bowstring is twisted dry grass.

lines.zh: 树倒了，你站的地方不对。
lines.en: Timber falls. You're standing in the wrong spot.
Stand firm. Don't let your bones rattle.

lines.zh: 百年的风，把我的弓弦吹硬。
lines.en: A century of wind hardened my string.
This branch comes down slow and heavy.

lines.zh: 草原的规矩，刻在我骨上。
lines.en: The savanna's law is carved in my bone.

lines.zh: 草原的日头把我的影子拉长了。
lines.en: The savanna sun has stretched my shadow long.
Hollow bones, solid branch.

lines.zh: 干草一踩就响，藏不住我。
lines.en: The dry grass cracks and gives me away.
New soil, unfamiliar grass.
Is the light through these leaves enough?
My bones aren't joined yet. Wait.
The savanna soil is cracked dry.

lines.zh: 没人打招呼，我就长这了。
lines.en: No one asked me. I'll grow here.
Iron smell, from the far side of the grove.
In the dry grass my bowstring sounds.

lines.zh: 我从干裂的土里站起来。
lines.en: I rise from cracked earth.
This dry ground cracks my bones.
This soil is damp — I like it.
Once the sun's warm, I'll speak.
The soil's deep enough. I'll root.
Dry grass is burning my ankle!
Bone broke, and I still draw.
Water's soaking me soft. No.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我埋进沙里半截。
lines.en: The blast buried half of me in sand.
The arrow's wedged in my shoulder blade.
Magic strikes my dry bones.
My roots pull up only sand.
Singed from head to heel.
No soil. My roots grab nothing.
